recipe_plan.black_policy: Light-only black-matte candidate: keep native-alpha witness; proposed normal preview A=max(P.r,P.g,P.b), P=round(A_native*C/255), straight RGB=round(255*P/A). Keep P exact, roundtrip<=1. Apply only to luminous layer; unknown owner blend is not established by this proposal.

previous_recommendation.reason: Dessins structurés, fins ou sensibles : préserver anneaux, runes, rayons, pointes, ondes et croisements ; éviter les inventions SeedVR observées au lot précédent.

recipe.fallback: Keep xBR; no generative repair of tiny glyphs, spokes, lightning or lattices.

recipe_plan.reason: Très petits grains, flocons, points lumineux ou gouttes : conserver séparation et silhouette ; exception xBR à la priorité SeedVR demandée.

recipe.alpha: Native alpha nearest4; feather0, erosion0; protect each particle
recipe.fallback: SeedVR comparison only if xBR result is insufficient; no automatic blur or merging of grains.

temporal.closed_loop: Only loop profile interpolates last-to-first; separate once profile when owner unresolved
temporal.constant_cycle: Store one image, preserve native duration; no hallucinated motion
temporal.empty_cycle: Preserve source carrier entry, no inference or playable profile
temporal.rate_basis: 15 FPS compatibility assumption; runtime rate not measured
temporal.tiny_frame: Temporary Apollo padding min128/multiple32, exact crop; world origin unchanged

final_assets.selection_reason: Observed SeedVR converts dark water/body pixels into decorative engraved patterns. Source32x32; preserve source appearance with proven WTRBODY1 xBR2/nearest2 method.

limits: SPCSPRAI accepted SeedVR is installed/tested under M3SPCS; canonical SPCSPRAI retains xBR comparison, separate future canonical routing required.
SP_DEMGT runtime alias exists but independent QA not inferred.
WTRBODY2 accepted earlier with native map unconfirmed.
No individual proof of every once/loop/profile or native consumer coverage inferred.
